newsitem.title: UK: UK's MAID, CompuServe plan business product.
newsitem.headline: UK's MAID, CompuServe plan business product.

text.p: British online information service provider MAID Plc and U.S. group CompuServe Corp said on Tuesday they would jointly launch abusiness intelligence service to enable CompuServe users to track U.S. industry information in a personalised, automated format.
The product, expected to be available in December, will help users to track investments, U.S. company information and news events, the companies said in a joint statement.
MAID will receive a proportion of all advertising and subscription revenues. MAID and CompuServe, a unit of H&R Block, signed a collaboration deal earlier this year.
